summary: Iter64 regression on Frasberg Game Builder v2 (server-status, shareable pages, new engine settings for laps/police/maze themes). Backend: 23/23 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter64_game_builder_v2.py — GET /api/game-builder/frasberg-status (public) returns reachable=false, status=403, detail mentions '403' + 'cloudflare', host api.frasberg.com; ?refresh=1 re-probes and updates checked_at. GET /engines exposes racer3d.laps (0..20) + lapLength (1000..10000), streets/carjack policeAggression (0.25..2.5), maze3d.mazeTheme type=select with options neon/ice/lava/jungle/crypt/desert/gold. Prompt rules verified: 'neon night race with 5 laps' -> racer3d laps=5 + raceRuleset.lapCount=5 name '5-lap race'; 'street race, 3 laps on a 4 km circuit' -> lapLength=4000 + track.lengthMeters=4000; 'Mob boss city with relentless cops' (engine=streets) -> policeAggression=1.9; 'GTA heist with lazy cops' -> carjack policeAggression=0.5; 'carjack with no police' -> 0.25; 'a maze in a frozen crypt' -> maze3d mazeTheme=ice; 'lava labyrinth' -> lava; 'haunted crypt maze' -> crypt. POST /worlds/{id}/refine returns 503 with 'frasberg server not answering' detail while upstream offline; POST /worlds/refine-pending returns {pending, refined:0, server:{reachable:false}}. PATCH /worlds/{id} with {laps:4,lapLength:2000} updates raceRuleset.lapCount & track.lengthMeters; {mazeTheme:'ice'} ok, {mazeTheme:'pizza'} -> 400 listing options. GET /public/{id} (no auth) returns name,tagline,engine_title,genre,cover_url(loads 200),highlights,creator,npc_groups,track,race_rules,vehicles; unknown id -> 404; worlds list items include share_path=/g/{id}. /worlds/{id}/play HTML for racer with laps contains lapPill/LAP markup; maze3d play HTML renders & includes mazeTheme in config. Frontend: /g/<bad-id> shows world-share-not-found card. /g/<validId> (logged OUT) renders cover image, 'Meta Maze · Puzzle' chip, title 'Night Meta Maze', Play button, Share button, Engine Settings grid including 'Maze theme: Ice', 'Build your own world' CTA. Clicking Play opens fullscreen world-share-player iframe; close button hides it. /game-builder (admin logged in): frasberg-server-status pill shows 'Frasberg server offline (HTTP 403 (blocked by Cloudflare)) — using keyword rules'; Re-check button works; building a maze3d world shows engine-tunable-mazeTheme select (value=ice); changing to 'lava' + Save & replay persists it (reloaded value=lava); engine-share-page link href=/g/<worldId>; engine-refine-btn clickable (toast error shown while offline); building a racer world via '5 laps' prompt renders engine-tunable-laps and engine-tunable-lapLength sliders. Upstream api.frasberg.com remains Cloudflare-403 blocked by user design — offline-state responses are EXPECTED.
critical_code_review_comments: game_world_builder.py grew to 819 lines — consider splitting prompt-rule mappers, engine catalog, Frasberg upstream, and REST routes into separate modules once the file crosses the 700-line guideline.

frasberg-status endpoint awaits a live Frasberg POST inside the request path when stale/refresh=1 (up to 8s timeout). Under a slow or hanging upstream this blocks the public endpoint; consider firing the probe as a background task and returning the cached state immediately.

PATCH /worlds/{id} mutates in-memory world then re-serializes without re-validating the full WorldDefinition pydantic model — _clamp allow-list protects today, but any future invariant on raceRuleset/track could slip through.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on checked flows (share page logged-out, builder logged-in: status pill, re-check, maze theme select+persist, share-page link, refine btn, racer laps slider)
